newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet,no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market quiet,no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
There were 11,500 head confirmed for the week to date. The last established price was 67.00 on Friday. Today's packer bids are 66.00-67.00 with asking prices 68.00- 69.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - Noon Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 11,500 Week Ago - 700 Year Ago - 1,000
